title: Apple may be developing its own AI agent that runs your Mac
lede: An Apple job listing, first spotted by Bloomberg, describes an in-house agent that would operate a Mac by browsing, working in apps, running commands and writing code.

points: The posting is for a senior engineering manager to lead an agent that uses a computer the way a capable person would.
It should pick the right tool per step and chain multi-step tasks across apps, browsers, the command line, code and APIs, while staying private.
Bloomberg says Apple has considered shipping as soon as the end of next year, but the project is still early.
macOS 27.3 will show warnings that discourage users from giving third-party agents full control of the Mac.
In October Apple told developers that granting that level of access would require very explicit action from the user.

sections.text: Developers shipping computer-use agents on macOS should expect more friction: Apple is adding consent gates for full-access permissions at the same time as it builds a first-party rival.
